# IVD degeneration clean variant 2

NP cell transcriptomics demonstrated consistent degeneration markers. FOXF1 was upregulated (Table 4). PAX1 was upregulated (Table 4). KRT18 was upregulated (Table 4). SOX9 was upregulated (Table 4). ACAN was downregulated (Table 4). COL2A1 was downregulated (Table 4). MMP13 was upregulated (Table 4). ADAMTS4 was upregulated (Table 4). TNF was downregulated (Table 4).
